_doc: Rules of the town builder (tools/city/, docs/protocolos/generar-ciudad.md). Offline only: the game reads the result (data/maps/<id>.json "decor"), never this file. Ids are scene ids of game/visuals/props/. Distances in tiles; curb/edge/wall = fraction of a tile the prop is pushed from its tile's centre towards the street, the plaza edge or the wall.
_decor_doc: Cosmetic dressing of the map made by tools/city/ciudad.py (vestir/generar), read only by WorldView (game/): the sim never reads it. kind house|yard|single: a filler lot (its tiles at..at+size); house: facing = the side of its door [dc, dr], flip = mirrored; lantern/prop/fence: one prop on tile `at`, off = pixel shift from the tile's centre. site: the item belongs to that map site (buildings of data/maps): a lot with site is the look of the site's footprint in a game without that building (drawn only then), a prop with site (a workshop's barrels) is drawn only with that building. Re-run the tool after editing rows or buildings.

filler._doc: Filler houses: one 3x3 lot per house, placed first where its front gives to a road within street_reach tiles; the door looks to that road: the look (as drawn, mirrored, its back view, back mirrored) is the one whose Door marker (data/building_sprites.json) is on that side. The houses, yards and the lone-tile prop come from data/view.json filler.

lanterns._doc: A lantern beside the street (grass or a yard, never a road, a door or its 8 neighbours) every `every` tiles (Manhattan, crossings first).

workshops._doc: Props by the door of each workshop type: against the wall beside the door when it is on a visible face, else on free tiles next to the door.

stalls._doc: A prop behind or beside each market stall (never on its service tile nor next to it).

plaza_benches._doc: Decorative benches on the edge of the plaza (backs to what borders it), at least `spacing` apart. The social points' benches (data/maps social_points) are drawn by the game apart from these.

generator._doc: tools/city/generator.py: houses = townsfolk houses at least (one per household of population_from's population, which the generated towns copy); town_reach = how far from the plaza's centre (tiles, the larger of the two axes) filler blocks go; max_filler = most filler blocks; fields = fields outside the town; tree_density = chance of a tree per free grass tile (x3 outside the town, x0.6 inside).

fences._doc: Fence segments on every edge of a field that faces something else (not water); a gate (gap) every gate_every road edges and on the trades' tiles.

plots._doc: Plots of the towns (docs/gdd/04_diseno_de_juego.md §4.9.1, tools/city/plots.py): free lots inside the town (filler lots, else open grass), outside it (open grass or fields beside a road), ruins (filler lots, else open grass) and the NPC businesses (every workshop and house site), each with its location 0-1. maps: the towns that must have them (the validator requires them and the counts). ruins / lots_inside / lots_outside: how many the builder tries; min_inside, min_outside, 1-3 ruins and valve (free plots of each zone: rustic, production, housing; 4.9's anti-blocking valve) are what the validator checks. for_sale: workshops with the «Se vende» sign, the best-located ones not in never_for_sale. min_area: the smallest filler lot taken. inside_walk: in a town without a town wall, a plot entered within this many steps (walking) of the plaza is inside, the nucleus (decision «Montsacre: dentro y fuera sin muralla de villa»); with a town wall, inside the wall. precincts: maps whose wall is a precinct, not a town wall (Montsacre's abbey, Church land): nothing is built inside it and its sides go by inside_walk. passes: the open-ground rects tried, strict to loose (sizes, gap clear around, road = entered from a road). location: weights of the plaza (walking distance), the main street (streets and plaza, within main_street_reach tiles), the gates and the traffic (walks from every door and gate to the plaza); [balance]. rule: la regla del owner (04 §4.9.1, 2026-11-06): production [mín, máx] parcelas libres de producción, al menos big de ellas del tamaño de un taller (big_sizes: 3×4 o 4×3, la huella mayor de la zona: forja, carpintería, cantería), y housing [mín, máx] de vivienda donde quepa house_size (una casa, 3×3; 4 por ciudad, decisión del manager 2026-11-07); el validador la exige en las seis ciudades; by_hand: los mapas que la cumplen a mano sobre el reparto de siempre (town_e: tools/maps/make_town_e.py, de posada).

greenery._doc: Rediseño de la ciudad (citylib.greenery, después de las parcelas y los puntos de reunión: no mueve nada del sim): árboles y vida de calle. Cada grupo (en orden de nombre): where (water: hierba a `reach` casillas del agua; meadow: hierba a más de `away` casillas de calles, casas y agua, solo hasta `edge` casillas del borde del mapa o solo más adentro de `inner`; street: hierba pegada a una calle de `roads`, lejos del agua; yard: un patio del relleno de los tipos `yards`; field: un campo rodeado de campo; plaza_edge: el borde de la plaza; gate_road: junto al camino, a gate_clear+1..+3 de una puerta), on (tipos de casilla), p (probabilidad por casilla, tile_hash), spacing (casillas mínimas entre piezas del grupo), apart (y con las de los demás), max, jitter (px de desplazamiento) e ids (escenas de game/visuals/props/; repetir = más peso). Nunca a gate_clear casillas o menos de una puerta (el corral de la feria), ni en puertas y sus vecinas, servicios, solares y sus bordes, puntos de reunión ni rondas.
